# Barakaz

> Barakaz is a global multi-vendor online marketplace headquartered in Canada, offering fashion, electronics, home & garden, health & beauty, and more from thousands of verified vendors worldwide.

## About

Barakaz connects buyers with verified sellers around the world. Vendors can register and list products, while customers enjoy a curated shopping experience with secure checkout and reliable international delivery options.

## Key Features

- Global multi-vendor marketplace with verified sellers
- Product categories: Fashion, Electronics, Home & Garden, Health & Beauty, Sports, Phones & Tablets
- Secure authentication (email, Google OAuth)
- Shopping cart and checkout with multiple international payment methods
- Order tracking and worldwide delivery options
- Vendor dashboard for product management, order fulfillment, and earnings
- Admin panel for platform management
- Multilingual support
